title: Interpretable XGBoost model flags obesity-depression comorbidity in inactive adults
summary: In 3,357 physically inactive Korean adults (KNHANES), an XGBoost model had internal AUC 0.783 and 0.744 and external AUC 0.886 in U.S. NHANES; SHAP identified insulin, white blood cell count and height as main predictors. The data are cross-sectional surveys, so associations are not causal.
ai_technology: XGBoost with random-forest feature selection and SHAP interpretation

evidence.tested: Internal validation in KNHANES and external validation in NHANES.
evidence.unknown: Causal effects and longitudinal performance are not tested; population and variable definitions differ between surveys; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Predicted obesity-depression comorbidity and ranked predictors.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
